name: Rospogenti
description: It is not known what caused the change in the children of the Ündercï, but so it was that some of their youth were born without gills and gasping for air. Outcasts by necessity, these newly divergent folk built a stilt city as near as they could to their departed home of Sotoonda, to which they longed to return. However, as generations begat generations, the Rospogenti found themselves uniquely positioned at the intersection of worlds: their city became a bridge between those above- and those under-wave. Despite attracting the ire of the world after the Potluck Plague originated here, the city has recovered speedily and is now one of the most diverse places in the world. The Rospogenti remain undisputed champions of bargaining and trade. While their station may seem humble compared to the Banking Houses to the west, here resides a great repository of deft cleverness, underestimated by the powers that be…
